question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.

The gift of the gab

options.text: The ability to speak easily and confidently

solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The idiom **"The gift of the gab"** means the ability to speak easily and confidently, especially in a way that makes people listen to you and believe you. (बातूनी और प्रभावशाली तरीके से बोलने की क्षमता)

 
 
• **Example: **He may not be the best businessman, but he certainly has the gift of the gab and can charm anyone.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Just at the last moment** (आखिरी पल में): Something happening right before it is too late.

 
 
• **Example:** She submitted her assignment just at the last moment.
 
 
 
• **Life full of quarrels** (झगड़ों से भरा जीवन): A life filled with frequent arguments and conflicts.
 
 
• **Example: **Their marriage was a life full of quarrels and disagreements.
 
 
 
• **Impossible** (असंभव): Something that cannot happen or be done.
 
 
• **Example:** It's impossible to finish this project in one day.
